name: Trap Bar Shrug
steps: Step inside a trap bar, grip both handles firmly at their centers, and stand tall with your arms straight at your sides.
Keep your core braced and elbows straight as you elevate your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Squeeze your upper traps strongly at the top of the shrug for a brief pause.
Lower your shoulders smoothly back down to a full stretch without letting your head jut forward.
tips: Lift straight vertically rather than rolling your shoulders in circles under heavy load.
Keep your elbows locked straight and your neck neutral throughout every repetition.
